result.notes:
I removed the original other_conditions trigger (demolition for new construction within 5 years of the filing) because it describes landlord conduct and the rule's event, not the buildings covered. It remains in the requirement text.

I set requires_unknown_facts to false. All RSO units are always Protected Units, and that class is identifiable from assessor data because it covers buildings built on or before October 1, 1978. The rule therefore covers ordinary rental buildings. Protected Unit status for non-RSO units and the household income tier cannot be checked by an address lookup, so they are listed as unverifiable conditions instead.

I did not set a construction_cutoff because non-RSO units can also be Protected Units.

The state Housing Crisis Act and the City rules operate together, with the owner paying the higher amount. That is not a supersession, so supersedes_state_rule and yields_to_local_rule stay null.
